function.name: write_file
function.arguments:
{"path": "lib/shipping/rates.rb", "content": "# frozen_string_literal: true

# Shipping module containing methods for calculating shipping costs
module Shipping
  ZONE_BASE = 5.99
  PER_KILO = 1.99
  FREE_SHIPPING_THRESHOLD = 10
  OVERSIZE_SURCHARGE = 5.00
  OVERSIZE_KILOS = 20

  EXPRESS_ZONE_BASE = 14.99
  EXPRESS_PER_KILO = 2.50

  module_function

  def shipping_cost(zone_or_code, weight)
    zone = zone_for(zone_or_code) || zone_or_code
    case zone
    when 'domestic'
      calculate_cost(FREE_SHIPPING_THRESHOLD, PER_KILO, OVERSIZE_SURCHARGE, OVERSIZE_KILOS, zone, weight)
    when 'eu'
      calculate_cost(FREE_SHIPPING_THRESHOLD, PER_KILO, OVERSIZE_SURCHARGE, OVERSIZE_KILOS, zone, weight)
    when 'international'
      calculate_cost(FREE_SHIPPING_THRESHOLD, PER_KILO, OVERSIZE_SURCHARGE, OVERSIZE_KILOS, zone, weight)
    when 'express'
      express_cost(weight)
    else
      raise ArgumentError, 'Unknown shipping zone'
    end
  end

  def express_cost(weight)
    cost = EXPRESS_ZONE_BASE + (weight * EXPRESS_PER_KILO)
    if weight > OVERSIZE_KILOS
      cost += OVERSIZE_SURCHARGE
    end
    cost -= FREE_SHIPPING_THRESHOLD * PER_KILO if weight >= FREE_SHIPPING_THRESHOLD
    cost = 0 if cost < 0
    cost
  end

  def zone_for(code)
    case code
    when 'GB'
      'domestic'
    when 'EU'
      'eu'
    else
      'international'
    end
  end

  private

  def calculate_cost(free_shipping_threshold, per_kilo, oversized_surcharge, oversized_kilos, zone, weight)
    cost = ZONE_BASE + (weight * per_kilo)
    if weight > oversized_kilos
      cost += oversized_surcharge
    end
    cost -= free_shipping_threshold * per_kilo if weight >= free_shipping_threshold
    cost = 0 if cost < 0
    cost
  end
end"}
